recentItems.title: BIONICLE Heroes After 20 Years | Ep #8 | Avak's Stronghold (ft. Takuma Nuva)
recentItems.description:
Join Eljay as he takes 13 guests through BIONICLE Heroes, the second BIONICLE game released for consoles. 

Every month, Eljay sits down with a new guest and they chat as Eljay plays through the different levels of the game as he works to 100% it and have a relaxing time chatting with people he knows and some he doesn't! Please join him every last Saturday of the month for the rest of the year on this endeavor!

recentItems.title: BioCraft: The Bohrok Update Teaser Trailer
recentItems.description:

This ain't no April Fools joke, it's really happening. Please stay tuned as we approach the release of this 10 episode series in the summer of this year!
